newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 12.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Libyan ambassador in France urges French companies to start businesses in his country.
- Arab airline companies need $15 billion in the next five years to buy 150 new aircraft.
- Egypt plans to sell shares in 15 companies worth $550 million.
- Bahrain accuses Qatar of escalating crisis between them.

- The Security Council might allow Iraq to double its oil exports if Baghdad adhered to its rules, analysts say. Iraq on Wednesday began pumping oil for the first time in six years under an oil-for-food agreement with the United Nations.
- Morocco plans to set up a free industrial zone.
- Jordan, Tunisia to discuss next week establishing a free trade zone.
